name: dobe_hold_key2
desc: Turn the hold into a real full nelson: the cat's arms are forced up and spread out to the sides, the monster's thick goo arms come from behind under the cat's armpits and bend upward, and its two hands press and lock together on the back of the cat's head and neck, pushing the cat's head forward. The cat dangles, struggling and kicking. Sticky pink goo strands smear over the cat. Keep the same Doberman head, smirk, body, colors, marble, puddle base, the same cat design and size, and the same pixel art style.
